6 Days / 5 Nights

Ladakh: High Passes & Blue Waters Expedition

Leh — Khardung La — Nubra Valley (Hunder & Turtuk) — Shyok River — Pangong Tso — Chang La — Leh

About This Trip

Experience the magical landscape of Ladakh across 6 days and 5 nights. Journey through the highest motorable passes like Khardung La and Chang La, explore the cold desert of Nubra Valley and Hunder, visit the last northern village of Turtuk, and marvel at the changing blues of Pangong Tso via the scenic Shyok River route. Complete with visits to Diskit Monastery, Leh Palace, Shanti Stupa, and Leh Market.

Itinerary

Arrive in Leh and rest for acclimitization. Later, explore Leh Palace, Shanti Stupa, and the vibrant Leh Market.

Drive over the world-famous Khardung La Pass into Nubra Valley. Visit Diskit Monastery and experience the sand dunes of Hunder.

Take a day trip to Turtuk, one of the northernmost villages in India near the Line of Control, known for its apricot orchards and rich Baltic culture.

Drive along the scenic Shyok River route to the famous high-altitude Pangong Tso Lake. Overnight stay at the lake campsite.

Witness the stunning sunrise over Pangong Tso, then drive back to Leh crossing the high-altitude Chang La Pass.

Transfer to Leh airport for your onward journey home with unforgettable Himalayan memories.
